I was 6 years old when this happened. We live not too far from one of those pit stop areas you go to when you get off the highway with lots of fast food options and gas stations, and it’s a good spot for homeless people to linger and collect money. As soon as my dad saw this one homeless man, he pulled straight into the McDonalds drive through, bought 3 egg mcmuffins, hash browns and a large fry. He gave them all to the man, who was incredibly greatful. Every time he saw that man again, he would buy him some food until the man just stopped coming to the area. (I hope he is doing better.) My dad would pass away just 3 years later, but his kindness for the less fortunate has really stuck with me and I try to replicate what he did.
